scenes.purpose: Show the complete original course-content diagram as the real evidence for practice activities and mock tests, uncropped and inside frame in landscape and portrait.

Three cards, each carrying a real crop of the course-content diagram plus a short label and qualifier, so the progression practice, free Speaking and Listening short courses, live expert webinars reads without empty card shells or narrow-lane wrapping.
Close on the exact approved CTA with the official site label held long enough to read, no rights badge in place of the call to action.

treatment.continuity: One warm off-white, navy and teal world taken from the course-content diagram. The teal accent carries from the title rule into the full diagram, through the three fact cards, to the CTA. Every card carries real material rather than an empty shell, and copy stays factual: no outcomes, scores, testimonials or Premium claims.
